name: ua_oblast_massive3_v1
signals_doc: l2_ru: share of RU panel posts with rule threat level >= 2; tc_<class>_ru: share of RU panel posts that are threats (rule r_threat) AND name a target class — energy (енерг/ТЕЦ/ТЕС/підстанц…), dc (дата-центр/ЦОД/серверн), rail (залізн/железнодор/депо/локомотив), vpk (ВПК/оборонн… завод/завод); thr_geo_ru: share of RU panel threat posts naming a city/oblast of THIS region (geo_regions()); tcg_ru: share of RU panel threat posts naming THIS region AND an infrastructure class (energy | dc | rail). All over the 24 h window ending 15:00 on D-1 (features.TC_RE, INFRA_RE)
features_doc: baseline features + signals (window ending at the cutoff and its 3-day mean); base/y2/y2_m7 from the real-time target ob_massive2 (lag_target), plus acled_l (log1p ACLED strike events of the oblast, latest week published before the cutoff) and acled_m8 (its 8-week mean): the oblast's real strike rate
